core.title: Stainless Steel Branch Pull, Acorn KPDJP

text.description_html:
Acorn KPDJP , Stainless Steel Branch Cabinet Pull

The Stainless Steel Branch Cabinet Pull gives off a slight impression of the great outdoors but manages to do it in a modern way. A little rustic and very chic, this cabinet pull by Acorn is perfect for log cabins and contemporary apartments alike--anywhere a tasteful reminder of the natural world is desired. Each one is crafted traditionally with a hammer and anvil, the marks of its handmade origins granting the cabinet pull unique character. Every one is a little different, a little work of art. The forging process darkens the Hand Forged Branch Cabinet Pull in an uneven pattern, providing a natural finish (similar to antique nickel or pewter). It is this natural stainless steel finish that is perfect for not only modern decors but also more traditional styles, able to accent this contemporary material with a natural feel that just seems to belong in any setting.

For over a half a century authenticity and function have been the way Acorn Manufacturing has produced some of the highest quality hand forged hardware and accessories from some of New England's finest Blacksmiths for your home.

Specifications of the Stainless Steel Branch Pull:

  • Finish: Stainless Steel
  • Material: Solid Stainless Steel
  • Length: 4"
  • Width: 1-3/8"
  • Projection: 1-5/16"
  • Package includes 1 pull and hardware for installation.

Sold individually. Due to the handmade craftsman nature of this product, all dimensions are approximate.
